basic_details.job_title: RGCB Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Under RGCB Recruitment 2026 (Adv. 17/2026), one Project Associate I position is open to Indian citizens. The post is in the ANRF funded project "Identification and Functional Characterization of Novel Short IRES Elements for Effective Circular RNA Translation: An Emerging Platform for Vaccines/Therapeutics", in the laboratory of Dr. Arun Sankaradoss, Scientist C, at BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram. The post lasts one year at first, or until the project ends if that comes sooner. Pay follows the prevailing ANRF guidelines. You need a First Class Master

qualification.details: Good academic record with a First Class Master's Degree in Life Sciences. A minimum of two years of documented experience in mammalian cell culture or handling laboratory animals, along with in-depth knowledge of virology.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online using the "Apply Online" link given with Adv. 17/2026 on the RGCB Careers page. Completed applications must be received by 26 October 2026.
Applications that are not in the prescribed format will be rejected without further review.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open only to Indian citizens. The notice says that only those who meet the criteria below need apply. Good academic record with a First Class Master's Degree in Life Sciences. A minimum of two years of documented experience in mammalian cell culture or handling laboratory animals, along with in-depth knowledge of virology. Qualified National Eligibility Test – CSIR-UGC-NET/LS, GATE, DBT-BET, ICMR, DST-Inspire Fellowship, JEST, or JGEEBILS. Experience in experimental virology, including virus culture, titration, in vivo challenge, and pathology. Proficiency in basic molecular biology techniques, including RNA isolation, protein gel electrophoresis, and Western blotting. Basic experience in microbiological techniques in a BSL-2 laboratory. Experience in basic laboratory maintenance, including ordering supplies, inventory management, report preparation, and assisting research staff. The NET/GATE-type qualifications are listed as desirable, not essential. The notice gives the age as 32 years as on 26 October 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay for the RGCB Project Associate I post will follow the prevailing ANRF guidelines. The notice does not print a monthly amount. The appointment is initially for one year or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. It can be extended based on a performance evaluation. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Project Associate I
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online using the "Apply Online" link given with Adv. 17/2026 on the RGCB Careers page. Completed applications must be received by 26 October 2026. Applications that are not in the prescribed format will be rejected without further review. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send their applications through proper channel. Anyone applying for more than one position must submit a separate application form for each position.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted for an online selection interview based on the eligibility criteria. Suitable candidates will then be selected based on their qualifications and their performance in the selection interview. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RGCB Recruitment 2026 (Adv. 17/2026)?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Project Associate-I in an ANRF funded project at BRIC-RGCB, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RGCB Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed applications is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for RGCB Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: You need a good academic record with a First Class Master's Degree in Life Sciences. You also need at least two years of documented experience in mammalian cell culture or handling laboratory animals, along with in-depth knowledge of virology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the RGCB Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age as 32 years as on 26 October 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of RGCB Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Pay follows the prevailing ANRF guidelines. The notice does not print a monthly amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for RGCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the "Apply Online" link on the RGCB Careers page by 26 October 2026. Applications that are not in the prescribed format will be rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RGCB Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Applicants are first shortlisted on the eligibility criteria and then called for an online selection interview. The final selection is based on qualifications and performance in that interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the RGCB Project Associate-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is initially for one year or until the project ends, whichever is earlier, and can be extended based on a performance evaluation. It is co-terminus with the project and gives no claim to future positions at RGCB.

faq.question: Q9. Is NET or GATE compulsory for RGCB Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: No. CSIR-UGC-NET/LS, GATE, DBT-BET, ICMR, DST-Inspire Fellowship, JEST or JGEEBILS are listed as desirable qualifications, not essential ones.
